reference.title: High pressure equation of state for solid argon from interatomic potentials

model_description: Monte Carlo pressure-volume isotherm using the Barker-Fisher-Watts pair potential and the Axilrod-Teller three-body interaction.
model_description_source: Primary full text, Section II (p. 1509), Figures 3–5; numerical method and potentials delegated to cited earlier papers.
phase_status: Solid argon verified in full text; no explicit fcc or hcp identification in this paper.
volume_normalization: cm^3/mol (Figures 3–5); derived atomic A^3 uses 1e24/N_A, no conventional-cell multiplier.

pressure_scale.note: Section II cites Mao 1978/1979 and possible 10% calibration uncertainty; no raw shifts or complete pointwise recalibration recipe.

experimental_comparison.note: Ross 1986 measurements replotted in Figures 4–5, not new Barker observations. Maximum experimental pressure 800 kbar; not a fitted model validity bound.

reproduction.note: Full text verified. Table I transcribed and selected Figure 5 curve/circles digitized. No standalone potential equations/coefficients or complete simulation protocol printed; not an independent Monte Carlo reproduction.

pdf.identity_evidence: Matching cover DOI, article title, J. A. Barker, journal volume 86 and all three printed article pages. Publisher URL is a locator, not a verified acquisition origin.

zotero.note: Empty searches predate coordinator import; current item/attachment keys are owned by integration task.

researchgate_followup.note: Exact title and DOI match; public page says no full text available, existing signed-in browser session offers Request full-text only. Institutional publishing-fee coverage notice does not provide article reading access.

parameter_uncertainties_status: No coefficient table or fitted uncertainties supplied. Mentioned 10% is a possible overall ruby-scale uncertainty, not pointwise one-sigma.

datasets.description: All seven Table I rows, 100 K, 27.04 cm^3/mol; one experimental reference row and six theory rows; all include quantum corrections per caption.
